ways.label: Mangawhai Cliffs Walkway, car park to rock archway and back

via.name: walkway sign
via.quote: the sign for Mangawhai Cliffs Walkway

evidence: From Mangawhai Heads car park, follow the beach north.
From here, it’s a steep descent with lots of steps down to the coast and a natural rock archway.
Return to the car park via the track, or the beach (low and mid tide only).

ways.label: Return via beach loop (low and mid tide only)

via.name: walkway sign
via.quote: the sign for Mangawhai Cliffs Walkway

evidence: At low and mid tide, you can walk from the rock archway along Mangawhai Heads Beach all the way to the car park.
Return to the car park via the track, or the beach (low and mid tide only).

doubts: Car park is at the end of Wintle Street; no road end feature for it, so ref null. W2 time/distance not given for the whole loop (4.8 km / 1 hr is the beach section only).
